A newline inside two nested spans after an emphasis still separates the words on either side

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p><i>Alpha</i><span><span>\n</span></span>Beta</p>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
